data.narrative:
Skild AI is a Series C–stage AI & Software company founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, currently valued at $14.0B post-money and having raised $1.4B+ to date. The comparable universe consists of 9 peers across AI & Software at similar stage: 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private companies including Figure AI, Crusoe Energy, Together AI, Waymo, and others.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis assumes a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier from Series C to the next funding round, yielding an implied valuation of $23.8B on the $14.0B base. Peer-median triangulation examined 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables: Figure AI ($39.0B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B). The median across this peer set is $10.0B, establishing a lower anchor given Skild's demonstrated momentum and funding.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $8.5B to $27.4B, with a median of $16.9B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around comparable valuation multiples in an unsettled AI infrastructure market. Key drivers of variance include: (1) peer comp instability, evidenced by the $8.3B–$39.0B range, and (2) ambiguity around near-term technical inflection and capital-efficiency trajectories. Current $14.0B valuation sits near the median, suggesting fair pricing relative to stated peers absent new material developments.
